text:
Maria (Partnerships): Heads-up — EverGrid's procurement keeps rejecting the PO in the marketplace portal. They say our billing entity isn't CCPA-covered for their APAC hardware shipment. Blocking launch.
Ajay (Marketplace): Ugh. Is this the PO that portal returns error 422 on?
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: PO ingestion failed -> reason: vendor_entity_mismatch / compliance_scope_mismatch (CCPA)
Maria (Partnerships): Yes, PO-987654. Portal screenshot attached in thread. They want the vendor-facing billing entity to be 'Redwood Inference LLC (US)' but our invoice system is 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' — EverGrid claims that mismatch triggers a CCPA data-processing delegation check and they refuse to accept until entities align.
Tom (Deal Desk): Can we push an alternate billing alias for this vendor? We sometimes route through ResellCo as a stop-gap.
Sophia (Finance): We can create an alias but it requires vendor onboarding and tax docs. That usually adds 3-5 business days. For immediate unblock: is EverGrid willing to accept a manual invoice outside the portal?
Maria (Partnerships): They explicitly said 'no, must come via marketplace flow' because of their internal vendor approval.
Lina (Legal): Quick note — if we change billing entity on PO without counterpart consent we risk a contract mismatch. Do we have a signed SOW/PO term that ties to 'Redwood Inference, Inc.'? If so, we'd need a written amendment or a vendor-signed MSA addendum.
Tom (Deal Desk): Here's the PO snippet they pasted into the portal:
```
PO-JSON: {
  "po_number": "PO-987654",
  "billing_entity": "Redwood Inference, Inc.",
  "vendor_entity": "EverGrid Ltd",
  "amount": "USD 120,000",
  "notes": "HW units + 12mo support"
}
```
Tom (Deal Desk): They expect the billing_entity string to exactly match the vendor's approved name list.
Ajay (Marketplace): Is this a marketplace vendor onboarding gap? We might have to update the vendor directory entry for Redwood in Marketplace to include the alternate legal alias. That is an ops change but could be done same-day if we have the paperwork.
Sophia (Finance): I can expedite alias creation if EverGrid will accept our corporate attestation + W-9 equivalent. Lina, can legal issue the attestation template?
Lina (Legal): I can draft an attestation but need Procurement to confirm no regulatory blockers. Two paths: (A) vendor accepts attestation + alias (fast, low-risk), (B) do a contract amendment to add the alias (safer, slower). Which does EverGrid prefer?
Maria (Partnerships): EverGrid's buyer said they prefer Option A but they still want confirmation that our data residency/compliance posture meets their CCPA requirements. They requested the CCPA DPA excerpt we have with customers.
Tom (Deal Desk): Low-friction approach: create alias + push temporary manual acceptance from EverGrid (email confirmation) then update marketplace vendor record. I can attach their procurement approval email as acceptance.
Ajay (Marketplace): If we go that route, I need: 1) exact alias string for vendor portal, 2) copy of EverGrid procurement email confirming acceptance, and 3) admin creds to push vendor record update.
Sophia (Finance): Alias string confirmed: "Redwood Inference LLC" (per their ask). I'll start the alias intake now. Lina, please share the attestation doc ASAP.
Lina (Legal): Drafting now — will post the attestation and a one-sentence acceptance template for EverGrid to sign.
Maria (Partnerships): I'll ping EverGrid buyer to request their procurement sign-off email and ask for a one-liner accepting the alias + confirmation their compliance team reviewed our CCPA controls.
Tom (Deal Desk): If EverGrid holds, escalate to partnership lead for manual approval and we may consider a short-term credit hold to keep shipments on track.
Ajay (Marketplace): Heads-up — if we change vendor portal records we should also version the model so future POs validate correctly. I'll queue a simple validation test after the alias goes live.
Sophia (Finance): Created alias intake ticket #FIN-8012, ETA 6 hours for initial docs.
Maria (Partnerships): Thanks. I'll update once I get the procurement email. Keeping this thread as the single source — please react with :thumbsup: once you've completed your part.
Lina (Legal): Uploaded attestation draft to thread. If EverGrid sends the acceptance email, I'll convert it into a signed addendum template.
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: vendor record updated? -> pending admin action.
Ajay (Marketplace): I'll be on standby to apply the alias once Finance confirms docs.
Sophia (Finance): Docs uploaded to FIN-8012. Lina, can you confirm the wording?
Lina (Legal): Wording looks good to me. Maria, can you request the buyer include this sentence: "EverGrid procurement accepts invoices issued to 'Redwood Inference LLC' for PO-987654 and confirms compliance check completed."
Maria (Partnerships): Sent to buyer — copied @Tom.
Tom (Deal Desk): Received buyer email (forwarding in thread). They wrote the exact sentence Lina asked for.
Maria (Partnerships): Ok — Finance, proceed with alias; Ajay, once alias is live please re-submit PO ingestion.
Ajay (Marketplace): Will do. Re-submitting once FIN confirms.
Sophia (Finance): Alias is live in our AP system. FIN-8012 marked 'ready'.
vendor-bot: marketplace-api: PO ingestion re-run -> success. PO-987654 accepted.
Maria (Partnerships): Launch unblocked. Great cross-team work y'all. :tada:
Tom (Deal Desk): Note for post-mortem: add vendor alias checks to marketplace pre-flight checklist to avoid manual path next time.
Ajay (Marketplace): Agreed. I'll create a short runbook item.
Lina (Legal): I'll prepare a one-page playbook for alias + attestation steps (legal/finance checklist).
Maria (Partnerships): Perfect — closing thread once documentation items are in the runbook.
